source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Good to hear from you, I hope your trip to Spain was fun! I have been doing a lot of work on the website and the UI and both are shaping up quite well. My priority right now is to finish fleshing out the website before it (hopefully) gets a lot of traffic.

I have added a header menu to the site (not yet live) with associated pages in varying levels of completeness. Two of these pages are solution descriptions for the platform and agents, per the attached snapshots. These pages each include space for a diagram for which I have created rough drafts.

I am hoping you can help me turn these into production versions that I can add to the site. If not maybe you can recommend the best approach to doing this.

I have also developed the UI further, which I am now calling the Console, and added more functionality. I have also finalized a look-and-feel and layout I am comfortable with, although it still needs a little bit of polish in terms of shades and tones. I will get you a link you can use to review it.

Regards,
Mark

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Spain was amazing! The food was delicious and the local history was very interesting but it's good to be back!

Yes, I'm happy to help with getting both of these diagrams production ready.
\- For the first diagram, do you want to add additional labels for "call", "email" and "text chat" for customers? What do the 3 other icons represent for staff?
\- For the second diagram, do you want me to add directional arrows around the cycle? Assuming the arrow should be going clockwise

Does it make sense to switch to an hourly contract at this point?

ambiguity.description: The diagram's use of directional arrows and the intended cycle direction require client confirmation.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Sounds good. I'm happy to switch to hourly contract for things like this. I can probably change it in our current contract. What rate shall I use? I just need to keep control of expenses at this point.
You can add "phone", "email" and "message" labels to customers and "chat", "message" and "report" to staff if this improves the diagram. Yes, clockwise direction arrows should be added to the second diagram.
